subject.title: fix(channels): prevent outbound echoes and expose native login

question: Should the public `plugin-sdk/channel-outbound` registry be accepted as the permanent cross-plugin contract for outbound echo suppression, rather than keeping this behavior owner-private to Discord?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive plugin API and shared ingress policy; source-level tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the long-term public ownership boundary.

options.title: Accept the shared SDK contract
options.body: Approve the public record/query API after reviewing live transport proof and retaining focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep the repair Discord-private
options.body: Limit the change to Discord thread-webhook echo handling and avoid exporting a general plugin SDK contract until multiple plugins need it.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the public record/query API after reviewing live transport proof and retaining focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history connects this contributor most directly to the proposed shared channel and plugin-SDK boundary.
